name: Alice Charlotte Cavendish
original_name: アリス・シャロット・キャヴェンディッシュ
source:
“Poor Alice Evelyn...”

The eldest daughter of the Earl of Cavendish. Believed by her father to be his illegitimate child, she is treated with contempt. It pains her to see her twin sister being the only one subjected to abuse. Despite her difficult circumstances, she remains kind-hearted, yet there is something slightly twisted about that kindness...

[Translated from the [url=https://dotaihen.xxxxxxxx.jp/an/alicenightmare.htm]official website[/url]]
